messages.subject: library caret in shinnio
parts:
Hi,

I used the caret library in my R shiny project to run some machine learning models and predict data. Everything goes fine in my local environment when runApp() to preview. However, when I deploy the project to shinyapp I get below error:
checking how to recognize dependent libraries... c################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 813684 failed: Error building image: Error building nloptr (1.0.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

Seems the package nloptr got some dependency issues on shinyIO? Anyone know how to fix that?


Bo

messages.author: 686ab6dc2c630995
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] library caret in shinnio
parts:
Hey Bo,
Currently, shinyapps doesn't support the nloptr package because it requires system level dependencies. We'll likely add support for it in the near future, but its not slated at the moment. Thanks.
